_comment: Was entirely hallucinated: '+2{p} if a Sword is in your ARSENAL'. The card reads 'Sharpen target sword you control twice' -- a keyword putting +1{p} counters on a weapon in the arena, nothing to do with the arsenal or with modifying this card's attack. The old version passed its generated test only because CARD_IN_ZONE silently ignored the 'subtype' key, so the condition degenerated to 'is your arsenal non-empty'.
